courses.title: Karma Clearing by Design with Chetan Parkyn
courses.description: A private programme with Chetan that works through guided meditation, a love-history clearing and a destiny-path clearing, read against your own Human Design chart, to bring old personal and ancestral patterns into awareness. It runs as a preparatory Zoom call, then either a full in-person day or two half-day Zoom sessions, followed by two integration mentoring calls.

courses.title: Karma Clearing by Design: Group Training with Chetan Parkyn and Carola Eastwood
courses.description: A three-day small-group training in which Chetan and Carola guide participants through the karma clearing process, starting from each person's own Human Design chart, with sessions on love history and destiny path opened and closed by guided meditation. It also introduces the method to practitioners who want to offer it to their own clients, and registration includes five online mentoring sessions.
